news.title: Prosecutors Examined Firm With Tie to Judge in Trump Hush-Money Trial
news.summary: The U.S. attorney in Chicago subpoenaed a fund-raising firm that had been co-owned by the daughter of Judge Juan Merchan, who conducted the trial that led to Donald Trump’s felony conviction.
